deskyard remote list: list saved remotes

Usage: deskyard [-e NAME] remote list [--json]

Lists the saved remotes; * marks the default.

Options:
  --json               print JSON instead of text

Prints: a table NAME URL TOKEN (token ID only); with --json an array of
  {name,url,environment,default}

Examples:
  deskyard remote list

Where: on this machine (no remote needed)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
